zh.title: 从研究，到科学家​手中的工具
zh.description: PhAI Labs 的产品：ScienceBuddy，越用越懂你的科研搭档；DiscoveryRSI，让每一轮研究成为下一轮的经验。
zh.lede: 每一个产品都来自我们的一条研究方向。

items.name: ScienceBuddy
items.tagline: 越用越懂你的科研搭档
items.lede: 把数据、图像和文献放进同一个工作空间，直接提问。它调用科学工具完成检索、计算和分析，每一步都留下记录。

video.label: 产品视频
video.play: 播放 ScienceBuddy 产品视频

features.title: 带着材料来提问
features.body: 文档、图像、表格和生物序列，和问题一起提交。

features.title: 科学工具，开箱即用
features.body: 22 个模块、224 个工具，覆盖基因组学、药理学、生物成像、文献检索与数据库查询，计算由 GPU 加速。

features.title: 每一步都查得到
features.body: 每次工具调用的输入和输出都有记录，结论有据可查。

features.title: 从你的反馈里学习
features.body: 你的追问、修改和采纳，都会成为它下一次做得更好的依据。

items.proof: 已在北京大学、复旦大学、上海交通大学、麻省理工学院、斯坦福大学​等科研机构​投入使用。

items.name: DiscoveryRSI
items.kind: 科学发现 · 递归自我改进
items.tagline: 让每一轮研究，成为下一轮的经验

features.title: 假设演变，可追溯
features.body: 每次修改都与证据和检验方案保持关联。

features.title: 关键贡献，能学习
features.body: 把找到证据、补充对照等贡献转化为学习信号。

features.title: 跨轮改进，再验证
features.body: 将通过评估的更新带到新的研究任务中检验。

en.title: Research, built into tools scientists use every day
en.description: Products from PhAI Labs: ScienceBuddy, a research partner that gets better the more you work with it, and DiscoveryRSI, which turns every round of research into experience for the next.
en.lede: Each one grows out of a line of our research.

items.name: ScienceBuddy
items.tagline: A research partner that gets better the more you work with it
items.lede: Put your data, images and papers in one workspace and ask. It runs the scientific tools to search, compute and analyse, and records every step.

features.title: Bring your material
features.body: Documents, images, tables and biological sequences go in with the question.

features.title: Tools, ready to run
features.body: 224 tools in 22 modules across genomics, pharmacology, bioimaging, literature search and database queries, on GPU-accelerated compute.

features.title: Every step on the record
features.body: Each tool call is logged with its inputs and outputs, so any answer can be traced.

features.title: Learns from you
features.body: Every follow-up, edit and approval teaches it, so the next run fits how you work.

items.proof: In use at Peking University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, MIT, Stanford University and other research institutions.

items.name: DiscoveryRSI
items.tagline: Every round of research becomes experience for the next
items.lede: From proposing a hypothesis to revising its plan, it records the evidence behind every step, learns which contributions mattered, and carries the improvements that pass evaluation into the next round of research.

title: How scientific hypotheses
get better, round by round
card.caption: DiscoveryRSI · From iterating on hypotheses to learning continuously

features.title: Every revision traceable
features.body: Each change stays tied to its evidence and its test plan.

features.title: Key contributions, learned
features.body: Contributions such as finding evidence or adding a control become learning signals.

features.title: Improved, then tested again
features.body: Updates that pass evaluation are carried to new research tasks and tested there.
